idea-plugin.name: Copilot Voice for Windows
idea-plugin.description:
Voice-to-text for GitHub Copilot Chat, built for heavily restricted Windows devices. Hold a shortcut, speak, release — your words are transcribed locally with a bundled whisper.cpp and dropped into the Copilot chat.

Made for locked-down machines where Windows built-in dictation is blocked and you can't build whisper.cpp from source: everything (prebuilt binaries + model) ships inside the plugin — no compiler, no admin rights, no network installs.
